name: smart-commit
description: Save all workspace files and commit them to git. Skips files open in the editor that are outside the workspace directory.

smartCommit.commitMessageTemplate.description: Default commit message template. Use {date}, {time}, {files} as placeholders.

smartCommit.promptForMessage.description: Show an input box to enter a custom commit message before committing.

smartCommit.gitUserName.description: Git user.name to use if not set globally (leave empty to use existing git config).

smartCommit.gitUserEmail.description: Git user.email to use if not set globally (leave empty to use existing git config).
